headline: New Border Bridge Between China and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Over the Yalu River Opens to Traffic
summary: The new Yalu River bridge between China and North Korea was officially opened to traffic. The crossing links the two countries' border economies.
why: Border infrastructure affects cross-border trade flows, logistics costs and the economic ties between China and North Korea.
